result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software depends on your business size, location, and how much of the payroll process you want automated.

**My overall recommendation is Gusto for US-based small businesses.** However, if you're in the UK, I'd recommend looking at Xero Payroll, BrightPay or Sage instead.

Here are my top choices.

## Best payroll software for small businesses (2026)

Primarily US-focused options unless otherwise noted.

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall)

- Easy to use.
- Automatic payroll tax calculations and filings.
- Employee benefits and HR tools.
- Good for small and growing businesses.
  
  US pricing reported from \$49/month + \$6 per employee.
  
  [Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for accounting integration)

- Integrates with QuickBooks accounting.
- Automated payroll processing.
- Useful financial reporting.
- Good for businesses already using QuickBooks.
  
  US pricing reported from \$50/month + \$7 per employee.
  
  [QuickBooks website](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/payroll/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero**

(Best for UK businesses)

- Payroll integration with accounting.
- Staff records and payroll reporting.
- Useful accounting ecosystem.
- UK payroll functionality depends on the plan and available integrations.
  
  [Xero UK website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. BrightPay**

(Best for UK payroll processing)

- UK PAYE and National Insurance calculations.
- RTI submissions to HMRC.
- Pension auto-enrolment support.
- Designed for payroll professionals and small businesses.
  
  [BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Sage Payroll**

(Best for established UK businesses)

- UK payroll and HMRC reporting.
- Pension and employee management.
- Payroll reporting and recordkeeping.
- Established accounting and payroll ecosystem.
  
  [Sage UK website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

These recommendations reflect 2026 comparisons and typical use cases.
